The Network Powering the
Digital Asset Economy

WalletConnect is the leading global connectivity network for wallets, financial institutions, DeFi, and agents. One platform enables secure, compliant money movement with any asset on any chain, via a single access point to 900M end users, thousands of institutions, and $2 trillion in value.

Docs
Download the State of RWAs and Tokenization Report

One integration to enable modern money movement at global scale.

  • $400B+$400B+

    Annual Transaction Volume

  • 900M900M

    End Users

  • 1000s1000s

    Institutions

  • 700+700+

    Wallets

A platform that powers the companies building the future of finance.

  • Trusted by industry leaders

    $400B+ in annual transaction volume already runs on WalletConnect, trusted by the world's leading wallets, fintechs, institutions, and millions of users.

  • Built to institutional standards

    Every connection is secure and built to stay reliable as you scale, with wallet verification ready for the compliance checks institutions require.

  • The largest digital asset ecosystem

    One integration connects you to 700+ wallets, 900M end users, and the widest range of funding sources in the market.

  • One integration, any asset, any chain

    Integrate once and support any asset on any chain, without building routing, connectivity, or custody yourself.

Products

Connectivity

Connect wallets to the app ecosystem, and every business to every wallet, through a single integration.

Explore connectivity

Payments

Accept, deposit, and settle digital asset payments through the largest wallet network, with any asset on any chain.

Explore payments

Compliance

Meet global and regional digital asset regulatory requirements on top of the flows you already run.

See how compliance works

Solutions

  • Financial Institutions

    Secure, compliant access to onchain money movement and markets

    Financial Institutions

  • DeFi

    Drive growth with secure infrastructure built for fast & powerful trading

    DeFi

  • PSPs & Merchants

    Accept stablecoin payments without changing your stack

    PSPs & Merchants

  • Fintechs & Neobanks

    The fastest way to fund and spend on your platform

    Fintechs & Neobanks

  • Retail Wallets

    Become the wallet users connect, spend, and manage everything with

    Retail Wallets

  • Institutional Wallets

    Institutional-grade onchain access, without leaving custody

    Institutional Wallets

  • Gaming Platforms & Prediction Markets

    Enable fast onboarding, funding, and payouts

    Gaming Platforms & Prediction Markets

  • Marketplaces

    Simplified payments & payouts for marketplace platforms

    Marketplaces

  • Chains & Foundations

    Bring users, traffic, utility and distribution to your chain, its token and stablecoin

    Chains & Foundations

Enterprise-Grade Security and Compliance

Wallets, exchanges, payment providers, and institutions build on WalletConnect to meet their security standards and regulatory obligations.

  • Proof of wallet control

    Cryptographic message signing proves the user controls the wallet they are transacting from.

  • Non-custodial network

    Funds never leave the user's wallet. The user signs and the network relays.

  • Verified connections

    Real-time domain checks against threat intelligence, with a trust signal the wallet can surface before a user signs.

  • Configurable acceptance

    Acceptance can be limited to the assets and chains permitted under a given regulatory perimeter.

  • Screening before authorization

    Sanctions and transaction screening can be run before authorization.

  • Travel Rule capture

    Originator information can be captured and transmitted in standard formats, including for self-custodial counterparties.

  • End-to-end encryption

    Sessions are encrypted from wallet to app, with no private key exposure.

  • Multi-region infrastructure

    The relay network runs across multiple nodes and multiple regions.

  • Independently audited

    SOC 2 Type II. Controls are assessed on a recurring basis by an independent auditor.

Case Study

A regulated digital dollar, moving at global scale

USDC moved $155.9B across the WalletConnect Network in H1 2026, from nine-figure custody transfers to over a million everyday payments and trades.

Read the case study

The standard is set

Enterprise-Grade Security and Compliance

Wallets, exchanges, payment providers, and institutions build on WalletConnect to meet their security standards and regulatory obligations.

  • Proof of wallet control

    Cryptographic message signing proves the user controls the wallet they are transacting from.

  • Non-custodial network

    Funds never leave the user's wallet. The user signs and the network relays.

  • Verified connections

    Real-time domain checks against threat intelligence, with a trust signal the wallet can surface before a user signs.

  • Configurable acceptance

    Acceptance can be limited to the assets and chains permitted under a given regulatory perimeter.

  • Screening before authorization

    Sanctions and transaction screening can be run before authorization.

  • Travel Rule capture

    Originator information can be captured and transmitted in standard formats, including for self-custodial counterparties.

  • End-to-end encryption

    Sessions are encrypted from wallet to app, with no private key exposure.

  • Multi-region infrastructure

    The relay network runs across multiple nodes and multiple regions.

  • Independently audited

    SOC 2 Type II. Controls are assessed on a recurring basis by an independent auditor.
